It does not specify the averaging formula or its analytic assumptions. The enclosing paragraph also explains that Riemann problems can incorporate a medium discontinuity together with an initial-data discontinuity, producing interface waves that include reflection and transmission, and that particular Riemann solutions explain classical coefficients for various problems. These are qualitative methodological claims, not a numbered averaging theorem.
